comparison.objective: Tune a shock absorber from observed stopping behavior versus locate engine top dead center using a piston stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use repeated physical trials; candidate adjusts and locks a damping parameter, while the record turns a crank to two stops, removes the stop, and sets a midpoint.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming low-rebound cycles versus both contact-angle observations and final crank placement within 2 degrees of TDC.
comparison.reason: Shared iterative observation does not outweigh different mechanisms, actions, and target measurements. Candidate response thresholds are incomplete.
